verdict.rationale: dlt's incremental-loading docs describe merge/upsert and full-load semantics per table (dlt-docs-18, dlt-docs-27, dlt-docs-49), and dltHub's orchestration/deploy docs explicitly mention 'backfill' and 'refresh' as first-class run modes alongside scheduling (dlt-docs-59, dlt-docs-78), implying single-pipeline-run reconfiguration rather than a full rebuild. However, there is no explicit walkthrough showing how to target/resync a single table (resource) independently while leaving the rest of the pipeline state untouched. Missing for 10: a concrete example/CLI command for backfilling or resyncing one specific resource/table without touching other resources, and independent/community confirmation that this works in practice.
